workItems.title: Ledger reliability
workItems.description: The ledger stays in balance after every failure.

wiki.content:
# Ledger

The ledger service records each settled payment as a balanced entry.

# Posting rules

Each entry has a debit line and a credit line with the same amount.

# Onboarding

Ask the platform team for access to the ledger database.
